full_prompt_en: A restrained abstract graphic composition places floating translucent red and charcoal discs against a warm gray-beige ground. Three strong vermilion oval forms occupy the upper center, middle right, and lower left, each with a dark circular core and dozens of hairline radial spokes. Around them, larger pale cream and smoky gray semicircles overlap like thin veils. Horizontal charcoal bands cut through several shapes and gather into a low, broad base at the bottom. Fine vertical black threads descend from the disc centers, crossing the darker bands and helping the stack hold together. The arrangement is asymmetrical but carefully balanced: the large upper red oval is answered by a lower red circle, while a central half-disc shifts the weight to the right. Open beige margins remain visible on all sides, giving the clustered forms space to breathe. Overlapping translucent layers produce subtle changes from scarlet to wine red, cream to warm tan, and light gray to nearly black. The fine lines are precise and unusually dense near the centers, where they create a gauzy optical vibration. Light appears flat and studio-even; depth comes from opacity, overlap, and transparent layering rather than modeled shadow. A quiet gray horizontal strip at the bottom grounds the floating shapes without becoming a literal floor. The surface is smooth and matte, with only faint paper texture, emphasizing the contrast between broad color fields and delicate hairline structure. The overall effect is poised, rhythmic, and quietly kinetic despite the still geometry.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅克制的抽象图像构图把漂浮半透明红与炭灰圆盘放在暖灰米色背景前。三块强烈朱红椭圆分别位于上方中央、中部右侧与下方左侧，每块都有暗圆核心和数十根发丝般放射线。周围更大的浅奶油与烟灰半圆像薄纱般叠压。炭黑水平带切过若干形状，在底部聚成一条宽阔低基座。细黑竖线从圆盘中心垂下，穿过较暗色带，帮助叠置结构维持整体。排列不对称却精心平衡：上方大红椭圆由下方红圆回应，中间半盘把重量移向右侧。四边留有开放米色边缘，让形状群有呼吸空间。半透明层叠使猩红转成酒红、奶油转为暖褐、浅灰变得近乎黑色。细线精确且在中心附近特别密，制造薄纱般视觉振动。光平坦而均匀；纵深来自不透明度、遮叠和透明层，而非塑形阴影。底部安静灰色横带锚住漂浮形，却不变成真实地面。表面平滑哑光，只有淡纸纹，强调宽色场与精细发线结构之间的对比。整体效果镇定、有节奏，几何形状虽静止却有轻微动感。
style_prompt_en: Restrained abstract graphic art layers translucent ovals, semicircles, and fine line fans on a matte warm-gray ground. Vermilion and wine red form a small number of concentrated accents; smoky charcoal, pale cream, and soft beige cover the wider area. Hairline radial spokes, sparse vertical threads, and thin horizontal black bands cross the translucent planes with delicate precision. Overlap changes the apparent hue and darkness, supplying depth without any cast shadow or perspective illusion. A clustered, asymmetric central stack is stabilized by a broad low band and generous open margins. The largest colored area sits high, countered by smaller lower and side accents, creating measured rhythm. Edges of filled shapes remain softly clean while the lines are extremely crisp. Illumination is flat and even, letting transparency and color-area relationships do the visual work. Fine paper grain may remain barely perceptible beneath the otherwise smooth surface. The result is airy, poised, and optically lively, with a balance of broad quiet fields and dense linear vibration.
style_prompt_zh: 克制的抽象图像艺术在哑光暖灰底上叠置半透明椭圆、半圆和细线扇形。朱红与酒红形成少数集中的强调，烟炭灰、浅奶油与柔米色覆盖更大面积。发丝般放射辐线、稀疏竖线和细黑水平带以精密方式穿过透明平面。叠压改变可见色相与深度，无需投影或透视幻觉。中央成簇而不对称的叠层由宽阔低带和充足开放边缘稳定。最大彩色面积位于高处，由下方和侧面较小强调相抵，产生经过衡量的节奏。填色形状边缘柔净，细线却非常锐利。照明平坦均匀，让透明度和色彩面积关系承担视觉工作。平滑表面下可留下几乎不可觉察的细纸粒。结果通透、镇定且有视觉活力，在宽阔安静色场与密集线性振动之间平衡。
theme_en: Floating translucent red and charcoal discs in a balanced abstract arrangement
theme_zh: 漂浮半透明红与炭灰圆盘组成平衡的抽象排列
name: Albert Koetsier
